condition: A z.object shape key named after an Object.prototype member (e.g. constructor, toString) reads the inherited function when the key is missing, so optional/default keys reject the input and z.unknown() keys accept it and copy the function into the output.
workaround: Don't use Object.prototype member names as schema keys. If you have to, preprocess the input so it is a null-prototype object (Object.assign(Object.create(null), input)) before parsing. This workaround isn't from the thread.
